sources.facts_and_applicability: FDO uses URI/mtime with optional size checks, warns of second-resolution collisions, and specifies cache-side temporary rename. Read-only open describes access permission, not immutable bytes. POSIX rename supplies atomic name replacement with filesystem conditions; it does not atomically capture or hash mutable source content.

sources.facts_and_applicability: Cloned tokens share cancellation; child cancellation does not cancel its parent. Tokens signal interest, not hard termination. Semaphore fairness is request-order FIFO including acquire_many head blocking. kill_on_drop defaults false; Unix process groups and prompt reaping require explicit supervision. These primitives do not settle shared-render subscriber ownership.
